sunray_px4ctrl_runtime_export_v1.description: Post-run export contract for Sunray ROS1 px4ctrl single-UAV runs.

reference_csv.command_template: export trajectory reference samples at 100 Hz to <reference.csv>

state_csv.command_template: export /uav1/mavros/local_position/odom or declared truth/state source to <state.csv>

rviz_screenshot.command_template: capture RViz review window after point cloud, UAV axes, and trajectory are visible

ros_log.command_template: save terminal or roslaunch log to <ros.log>

review_requirements: RViz fixed frame is declared and stable
UAV body axes are visible at the aircraft center
trajectory line is visible and belongs to the same run_id
point cloud or map layer is nonempty when the display profile requires it

sunray_fastlio_eval_runtime_export_v1.description: Post-run export contract for Sunray ROS1 px4ctrl runs with FAST-LIO evaluated in parallel only.

reference_csv.command_template: export trajectory reference samples at 100 Hz to <reference.csv>

state_csv.command_template: export the declared FAST-LIO evaluation or control-state comparison stream to <state.csv>

localization_csv.command_template: export time-aligned FAST-LIO estimate and Gazebo truth samples to <localization.csv>

map_summary_json.command_template: save FAST-LIO map completeness summary JSON to <map_summary.json>

rviz_screenshot.command_template: capture RViz review window after point cloud, UAV axes, and trajectory are visible

ros_log.command_template: save terminal or roslaunch log to <ros.log>

review_requirements: RViz fixed frame is declared and stable
UAV body axes are visible at the aircraft center
trajectory line is visible and belongs to the same run_id
FAST-LIO map or point cloud layer is nonempty
FAST-LIO is recorded as evaluation-only and not as controller state

sunray_fastlio_px4_ekf_runtime_export_v1.description: Post-run export contract for Sunray ROS1 px4ctrl runs using FAST-LIO fused through PX4 EKF.

reference_csv.command_template: export trajectory reference samples at 100 Hz to <reference.csv>

state_csv.command_template: export PX4/MAVROS local state after FAST-LIO external odometry fusion to <state.csv>

rviz_screenshot.command_template: capture RViz review window after point cloud, UAV axes, and trajectory are visible

ros_log.command_template: save terminal or roslaunch log to <ros.log>

review_requirements: RViz fixed frame is declared and stable
UAV body axes are visible at the aircraft center
trajectory line is visible and belongs to the same run_id
FAST-LIO map or point cloud layer is nonempty
PX4/MAVROS local state is the exported fused state after FAST-LIO EKF fusion

sunray_fastlio_hybrid_z_runtime_export_v.description: Post-run export contract for Sunray ROS1 px4ctrl runs using FAST-LIO XY/Yaw and Gazebo rangefinder-surrogate Z.

reference_csv.command_template: export trajectory reference samples at 100 Hz to <reference.csv>

state_csv.command_template: export hybrid FAST-LIO XY/Yaw plus Gazebo Z state stream to <state.csv>

rviz_screenshot.command_template: capture RViz review window after point cloud, UAV axes, and trajectory are visible

ros_log.command_template: save terminal or roslaunch log to <ros.log>

review_requirements: RViz fixed frame is declared and stable
UAV body axes are visible at the aircraft center
trajectory line is visible and belongs to the same run_id
FAST-LIO map or point cloud layer is nonempty
Z state source is explicitly the Gazebo rangefinder surrogate
